message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "override_negative_automated_findings_with_visual_inspection", "description": "When automated chest X-ray analysis tools return negative or non-specific results for cases with suspected subtle structural anomalies, bypass the tool outputs and perform direct visual inspection of image pixels.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable when interpreting medical imaging (specifically chest X-rays) where clinical suspicion of congenital or subtle structural anomalies exists, but automated reporting and classification tools fail to identify specific pathological markers.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_report_generator", "chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_report_generator` and `chest_xray_classifier` both return negative or non-specific findings (e.g., 'no acute process', empty strong_findings) in a case with suspected subtle congenital or structural anomalies: (1) Do not conclude normality based on these tool outputs; (2) Bypass the automated conclusions; (3) Perform direct visual inspection of the image pixels to identify specific anatomical markers (e.g., absent bronchus, kinked vessels) that automated tools may miss."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
